connector.name: Toon Memory
connector.registryDescription: Offline persistent memory for AI coding agents - 35 tools, 80% fewer calls, no LLM
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package toon-memory. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the luiggival08 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TOON_MEMORY_KEY
env.description: Encryption key for AES-256-GCM memory encryption

env.name: TOON_MEMORY_CAPTURE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable activity capture hooks

env.name: TOON_MEMORY_BRANCH
env.description: Override the auto-detected git branch name

env.name: TOON_MEMORY_NO_SESSION
env.description: Set to disable session heartbeat tracking

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub personal access token for exporting/importing memory to Gist
